title: Runtime observations refused by a transient Engram store state (projection repair) exhaust 8 retries in about 4 minutes and are lost for good
outcome: A runtime observation whose report preparation or delivery is refused by a transient Engram store state (projection_repair_required or work_projection_invalid during a post-install repair, or a temporarily unopenable store) is retained and retried until the store is ready, then reported with its checks eligible for credit, instead of becoming terminal "not reported to Engram" after a fixed retry budget.
acceptance: Engram refusals that are transient by typed code (at least projection_repair_required and work_projection_invalid) are retryable without consuming the terminal attempt budget, or use a store-ready-gated wait, so an observation survives a repair window of at least 1 hour; permanent refusals still end terminal with the existing readable notice.

A behavioural test drives a closing job through transient store refusals longer than the current 8-attempt backoff, then a ready store, and shows the observation is reported once (no duplicate) with its checks credit-eligible; a second test shows a permanent refusal still ends terminal with a readable reason.
The review pair is clean and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
